lab_questions.title: Parking Fee Calculation & Duplicate Checkout Charges
lab_questions.description: Debug and fix 3 critical parking fee calculation, validation, and concurrency bugs in a Django REST Framework checkout API. Enforce an hourly round-up billing policy, reject checkout on non-existent or already-completed sessions, and prevent duplicate checkout charges under repeated or concurrent requests.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Calculate Parking Duration Correctly
tasks.description:
The checkout API calculates parking fees incorrectly when a vehicle stays for part of an hour due to integer truncation.

**Testing in Swagger UI:**
1. Open preview to view the Swagger UI.
2. Submit a checkout request `POST /api/parking/checkout/` for a session lasting 1 hour and 15 minutes.
3. Observe that the API incorrectly charges for 1 hour ($10.00) instead of rounding up to 2 hours ($20.00).

**Goal:** Refactor the fee calculation in `parking/views.py` to enforce the hourly round-up policy so partial hours are billed for the next full hour.

tasks.title: Reject Invalid Checkout Requests
tasks.description:
The system allows checkout when a vehicle has no active parking session or when its session has already ended.

**Testing in Swagger UI:**
1. Submit a `POST /api/parking/checkout/` request with a non-existent `session_id` or a session that has already completed.
2. Observe that the API accepts the checkout and generates additional charges.

**Goal:** Ensure invalid checkout requests are rejected with **HTTP 404** (if missing) or **HTTP 400 Bad Request** (if completed/inactive) without creating a charge.

tasks.title: Prevent Duplicate Checkout Charges
tasks.description:
Repeated or simultaneous checkout requests create multiple charges for the same parking session.

**Expected Behavior:**
- A parking session must be charged exactly once.
- Repeated sequential checkout requests must not create additional charges.
- Simultaneous checkout requests must not result in duplicate charges.
- Use appropriate transactions (`transaction.atomic()`), locking (`select_for_update()`), or idempotency checks to prevent race conditions.

**Goal:** Ensure that checkout requests are idempotent and duplicate charges are prevented.
